technique_name: Summarise the characteristics of a Jupyter notebook.
description: A Jupyter notebook is an interactive computing environment that allows users to combine code, visualizations, data, and explanatory text all in one place. It is open-source and runs on multiple platforms, including Windows, macOS, and Linux. The notebook allows users to run code and edit within a web browser, with support for multiple languages, including Python, Julia, and R.
